name: restore-failure-keeps-target-excluded
invariant: An unrestored evidence run blocks its target: the run is collected, the controller crashes before cleanup, the restore fails and the controller restarts again. Across both restarts the run publishes nothing and a new job on the target is refused (capacity_reserved_full); once a restore is verified, the run settles with its draft and the target serves the next job (13 [G5]; 05 "Evidence-target leases"; 11 intake).
